t: You're looking at St Mary's, Battersea, the oldest of the churches here. Christians have worshipped on this site continuously since around 800 AD, and the building is Grade I listed. Several people of note are buried here. Benedict Arnold, the American general who defected to the British in 1780 after the plot to surrender West Point was discovered, lies here. So does Henry St John, Viscount Bolingbroke, the Tory politician who supported the Jacobite rebellion of 1715. The botanist William Curtis is buried here too, along with John Inglis, the third Bishop of Nova Scotia.
